title: tracy-web brings every EmDash site's frame policy up to date when it starts, not when its owner opens it
steps: S1: start the frame policy warm-up over three EmDash sites, the second of which fails its check.
expect: S1: only sites with platform 'emdash' are read; they are checked one at a time, never two at once; the failing site does not stop the third; the count of ready sites is logged at the end.
evidence: Issue #205: the first open of an EmDash site after an image update restarted its container to add the frame policy, and the owner waited on a blank preview

tests: a serving tracy-web brings every EmDash site’s policy up to date at start, one at a time (#205)
